% Pattern: proof/attach/announce. \renewcommand{\proofname}{Proof of
% \thmref{t}} just before a proof announces what it proves. Seen in the gold
% pilot (set X).
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1 status=here labels=main
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 2 status=here labels=aux
% want proof-1 proof - proves=lemma-1
% want proof-2 proof - proves=theorem-1
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\newtheorem{lemma}[theorem]{Lemma}
\newcommand{\thmref}[1]{Theorem~\ref{#1}}
\begin{document}
\begin{theorem}\label{main} Every compact space is bounded. \end{theorem}
\begin{lemma}\label{aux} Every finite union of balls is bounded. \end{lemma}
\begin{proof} Take the largest radius. \end{proof}

\renewcommand{\proofname}{Proof of \thmref{main}}
\begin{proof} Take a finite cover and apply Lemma \ref{aux}. \end{proof}
\renewcommand{\proofname}{Proof}
\end{document}
